description: Download historical data over a from/to date range and save files locally as JSON, CSV, or both. second bars create one /history request per day, minute/hour bars create one /history request per month, and day/week/month bars use one /series request with dp=30000 and date filtering. Continuous futures ending in 1! or 2! are detected automatically and expanded to specific contract codes for second/minute/hour. Shows progress in the final summary and supports concurrency 1-10, default 5.

bar_type.description: Bar type. second/minute/hour use /history; day/week/month use /series.

concurrency.description: Concurrent API requests. Higher values can finish faster but may hit rate limits. Default is 5.

contract_lookback_months.description: Months of prior contracts to include when expanding continuous futures. Default is 6.

format.description: Output file format. Use both to write JSON chunks and CSV output. Default is csv.

from.description: Start date. Use YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

keep_chunks.description: Keep per-request CSV chunk files after merged CSV is written. Default is false.

merge.description: Write one merged CSV file for the whole run when format is csv or both. Default is true.

output_dir.description: Directory where downloaded files should be stored.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output files instead of resuming or skipping matching chunks. Default is false.

settlement.description: Set settlement as daily close. Default is false.

split.description: Split adjustment for equities and ETFs. When false, returns non-split-adjusted data and dadj is ignored. Default is true.

symbol.description: Symbol code in EXCHANGE:SYMBOL format, e.g. NASDAQ:AAPL

to.description: End date. Use YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

name: download_history
